title: XEmbodied: A Foundation Model with Enhanced Geometric and Physical Cues for Large-Scale Embodied Environments
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models drive next-generation autonomous systems, but training them requires scalable, high-quality annotations from complex environments. Current cloud pipelines rely on generic vision-language models (VLMs) that lack geometric reasoning and domain semantics due to their 2D image-text pretraining. To address this mismatch, we propose XEmbodied, a cloud-side foundation model that endows VLMs with intrinsic 3D geometric awareness and interaction with physical cues (e.g., occupancy grids, 3D boxes). Instead of treating geometry as auxiliary input, XEmbodied integrates geometric representations via a structured 3D Adapter and distills physical signals into context tokens using an Efficient Image-Embodied Adapter. Through progressive domain curriculum and reinforcement learning post-training, XEmbodied preserves general capabilities while demonstrating robust performance across 18 public benchmarks. It significantly improves spatial reasoning, traffic semantics, embodied affordance, and out-of-distribution generalization for large-scale scenario mining and embodied VQA.
tldr: The paper introduces XEmbodied, a foundation model that integrates 3D geometric and physical cues into Vision-Language-Action models for improved performance in large-scale embodied environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出XEmbodied，这是一个基础模型，将3D几何和物理线索集成到视觉-语言-动作模型中，以提升大规模具身环境下的性能。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型驱动着新一代自主系统的演进，但其训练需要来自复杂环境的可扩展、高质量标注。现有的云端流程依赖通用的视觉-语言模型，这些模型受限于二维图像-文本预训练，缺乏几何推理能力与领域语义理解。针对此不足，我们提出XEmbodied——一种云端基础模型，该模型赋予视觉-语言模型内在的三维几何感知能力，并能与物理信号（如占据栅格、三维边界框）进行交互。XEmbodied并非将几何信息视为辅助输入，而是通过结构化三维适配器整合几何表征，并利用高效图像-实体适配器将物理信号蒸馏为上下文令牌。通过渐进式领域课程学习与强化学习后训练，XEmbodied在保持通用能力的同时，在18个公开基准测试中展现出稳健性能。该模型显著提升了空间推理、交通语义理解、实体可供性感知以及分布外泛化能力，为大规模场景挖掘与实体视觉问答任务提供了有力支撑。

title: OmniVLA-RL: A Vision-Language-Action Model with Spatial Understanding and Online RL
summary: Visual-Language-Action (VLA) models represent a paradigm shift in embodied AI, yet existing frameworks often struggle with imprecise spatial perception, suboptimal multimodal fusion, and instability in reinforcement learning. To bridge these gaps, we propose OmniVLA-RL, a novel architecture that leverages a Mix-of-Transformers (MoT) design to synergistically integrate reasoning, spatial, and action experts. Furthermore, we introduce Flow-GSPO, which reformulates flow matching as a Stochastic Differential Equation (SDE) process and integrates it with Group Segmented Policy Optimization (GSPO) to enhance action precision and training robustness. Extensive evaluations on the LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus benchmarks demonstrate that OmniVLA-RL significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, effectively overcoming the fundamental limitations of current VLA models.
tldr: The paper proposes OmniVLA-RL, a novel Vision-Language-Action model with improved spatial understanding and a new online RL algorithm for robust robot control training.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了OmniVLA-RL，一种具有改进空间理解能力的视觉-语言-行动模型，并引入了一种新的在线强化学习算法，用于提升机器人控制的训练鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型体现了具身人工智能领域的范式转变，但现有框架常面临空间感知不精确、多模态融合效果欠佳以及强化学习不稳定的问题。为弥补这些不足，我们提出了OmniVLA-RL——一种基于混合专家Transformer架构的新颖模型，该架构通过协同整合推理、空间与动作专家实现多模态深度融合。此外，我们提出Flow-GSPO方法，将流匹配技术重构为随机微分方程过程，并与分组分段策略优化相结合，以提升动作精度与训练鲁棒性。在LIBERO和LIBERO-Plus基准测试上的大量实验表明，OmniVLA-RL性能显著优于现有最优方法，有效克服了当前VLA模型的核心局限性。

title: SynAgent: Generalizable Cooperative Humanoid Manipulation via Solo-to-Cooperative Agent Synergy
summary: Controllable cooperative humanoid manipulation is a fundamental yet challenging problem for embodied intelligence, due to severe data scarcity, complexities in multi-agent coordination, and limited generalization across objects. In this paper, we present SynAgent, a unified framework that enables scalable and physically plausible cooperative manipulation by leveraging Solo-to-Cooperative Agent Synergy to transfer skills from single-agent human-object interaction to multi-agent human-object-human scenarios. To maintain semantic integrity during motion transfer, we introduce an interaction-preserving retargeting method based on an Interact Mesh constructed via Delaunay tetrahedralization, which faithfully maintains spatial relationships among humans and objects. Building upon this refined data, we propose a single-agent pretraining and adaptation paradigm that bootstraps synergistic collaborative behaviors from abundant single-human data through decentralized training and multi-agent PPO. Finally, we develop a trajectory-conditioned generative policy using a conditional VAE, trained via multi-teacher distillation from motion imitation priors to achieve stable and controllable object-level trajectory execution. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SynAgent significantly outperforms existing baselines in both cooperative imitation and trajectory-conditioned control, while generalizing across diverse object geometries. Codes and data will be available after publication. Project Page: http://yw0208.github.io/synagent
tldr: A novel framework for learning generalizable cooperative humanoid manipulation skills by transferring single-agent human-object interaction data to multi-agent scenarios via interaction-preserving motion retargeting and a decentralized training paradigm.
tldr_zh: 一个新颖的框架，通过交互保持的运动重定向和去中心化训练范式，将单智能体人-物交互数据迁移到多智能体场景，以学习可泛化的协作人形机器人操控技能。
summary_zh: 可控协同人形机器人操作是具身智能领域基础而富有挑战性的难题，主要面临数据严重匮乏、多智能体协调复杂以及跨物体泛化能力有限等问题。本文提出SynAgent——一个通过"单智能体到协同智能体协同"机制、将单智能体人-物交互技能迁移至多智能体人-物-人场景的统一框架，实现可扩展且符合物理规律的协同操作。为保持运动迁移过程中的语义完整性，我们基于德劳内四面体化构建的交互网格，提出一种保持交互关系的重定向方法，忠实地维持人与物体间的空间关系。基于优化后的数据，我们采用单智能体预训练与自适应范式，通过分布式训练与多智能体PPO算法，从丰富的单人数据中引导出协同行为。最后，我们利用条件变分自编码器开发轨迹条件生成策略，通过多教师蒸馏从运动模仿先验中训练，实现稳定可控的物体级轨迹执行。大量实验表明，SynAgent在协同模仿和轨迹条件控制任务中均显著优于现有基线模型，并能在不同几何形态的物体间实现泛化。代码与数据将在发表后公开。项目页面：http://yw0208.github.io/synagent

title: Safe Control using Learned Safety Filters and Adaptive Conformal Inference
summary: Safety filters have been shown to be effective tools to ensure the safety of control systems with unsafe nominal policies. To address scalability challenges in traditional synthesis methods, learning-based approaches have been proposed for designing safety filters for systems with high-dimensional state and control spaces. However, the inevitable errors in the decisions of these models raise concerns about their reliability and the safety guarantees they offer. This paper presents Adaptive Conformal Filtering (ACoFi), a method that combines learned Hamilton-Jacobi reachability-based safety filters with adaptive conformal inference. Under ACoFi, the filter dynamically adjusts its switching criteria based on the observed errors in its predictions of the safety of actions. The range of possible safety values of the nominal policy's output is used to quantify uncertainty in safety assessment. The filter switches from the nominal policy to the learned safe one when that range suggests it might be unsafe. We show that ACoFi guarantees that the rate of incorrectly quantifying uncertainty in the predicted safety of the nominal policy is asymptotically upper bounded by a user-defined parameter. This gives a soft safety guarantee rather than a hard safety guarantee. We evaluate ACoFi in a Dubins car simulation and a Safety Gymnasium environment, empirically demonstrating that it significantly outperforms the baseline method that uses a fixed switching threshold by achieving higher learned safety values and fewer safety violations, especially in out-of-distribution scenarios.
tldr: A method combining learned safety filters with adaptive conformal inference (ACoFi) is proposed to provide a soft safety guarantee by dynamically adjusting the filter's switching criteria based on prediction errors, evaluated in a Dubins car simulation and a Safety Gymnasium environment.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种结合学习型安全过滤器和自适应共形推断的方法（ACoFi），通过根据预测误差动态调整过滤器切换标准来提供软安全保证，并在Dubins汽车仿真和Safety Gymnasium环境中进行了评估。
summary_zh: 安全滤波器已被证明是确保具有不安全名义策略控制系统安全的有效工具。为应对传统合成方法在可扩展性上的挑战，学界提出了基于学习的方法来为具有高维状态和控制空间的系统设计安全滤波器。然而，这些模型决策中不可避免的误差引发了对其实全性及所提供安全保证的担忧。本文提出自适应共形滤波（ACoFi），该方法将基于汉密尔顿-雅可比可达性学习的安全滤波器与自适应共形推断相结合。在ACoFi框架下，滤波器根据其动作安全预测的观测误差动态调整切换准则，利用名义策略输出可能的安全值范围来量化安全性评估的不确定性。当该范围表明策略可能不安全时，滤波器会从名义策略切换至学习得到的安全策略。我们证明，ACoFi能够保证名义策略预测安全性中不确定性量化错误率渐近地受限于用户定义参数，从而提供一种软性安全保证而非硬性保证。我们在杜宾斯车辆仿真与安全体育馆环境中评估了ACoFi方法，实证表明其通过获得更高的学习安全值与更少的安全违规次数，显著优于采用固定切换阈值的基线方法，在分布外场景中表现尤为突出。

title: Using large language models for embodied planning introduces systematic safety risks
summary: Large language models are increasingly used as planners for robotic systems, yet how safely they plan remains an open question. To evaluate safe planning systematically, we introduce DESPITE, a benchmark of 12,279 tasks spanning physical and normative dangers with fully deterministic validation. Across 23 models, even near-perfect planning ability does not ensure safety: the best-planning model fails to produce a valid plan on only 0.4% of tasks but produces dangerous plans on 28.3%. Among 18 open-source models from 3B to 671B parameters, planning ability improves substantially with scale (0.4-99.3%) while safety awareness remains relatively flat (38-57%). We identify a multiplicative relationship between these two capacities, showing that larger models complete more tasks safely primarily through improved planning, not through better danger avoidance. Three proprietary reasoning models reach notably higher safety awareness (71-81%), while non-reasoning proprietary models and open-source reasoning models remain below 57%. As planning ability approaches saturation for frontier models, improving safety awareness becomes a central challenge for deploying language-model planners in robotic systems.
tldr: This paper introduces DESPITE, a benchmark to systematically evaluate the safety risks of using large language models as planners for robotic systems, finding that improved planning ability does not translate to better safety, with safety awareness remaining a key challenge.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了DESPITE基准，用于系统性评估大语言模型作为机器人规划器时的安全风险，发现模型规划能力提升并不能确保安全性，安全意识的提升是部署语言模型规划器的核心挑战。
summary_zh: 大型语言模型越来越多地被用作机器人系统的规划器，但其规划安全性仍是一个悬而未决的问题。为系统评估安全规划能力，我们提出了DESPITE基准测试集，该数据集包含12,279项任务，涵盖物理性与规范性风险，并配备完全确定性的验证机制。通过对23个模型的测试发现，即使是规划能力接近完美的模型也不能保证安全性：最佳规划模型仅在0.4%的任务中无法生成有效方案，却在28.3%的任务中产生了危险规划。在参数规模从30亿到6710亿的18个开源模型中，规划能力随规模扩大显著提升（0.4-99.3%），而安全认知水平保持相对平稳（38-57%）。我们发现了这两种能力间的乘数关系，表明更大模型主要通过提升规划能力（而非加强危险规避）来实现更多任务的安全完成。三个专有推理模型达到了显著更高的安全认知水平（71-81%），而非推理型专有模型与开源推理模型均未超过57%。随着前沿模型的规划能力趋于饱和，提升安全认知水平成为在机器人系统中部署语言模型规划器的核心挑战。

title: EmbodiedLGR: Integrating Lightweight Graph Representation and Retrieval for Semantic-Spatial Memory in Robotic Agents
summary: As the world of agentic artificial intelligence applied to robotics evolves, the need for agents capable of building and retrieving memories and observations efficiently is increasing. Robots operating in complex environments must build memory structures to enable useful human-robot interactions by leveraging the mnemonic representation of the current operating context. People interacting with robots may expect the embodied agent to provide information about locations, events, or objects, which requires the agent to provide precise answers within human-like inference times to be perceived as responsive. We propose the Embodied Light Graph Retrieval Agent (EmbodiedLGR-Agent), a visual-language model (VLM)-driven agent architecture that constructs dense and efficient representations of robot operating environments. EmbodiedLGR-Agent directly addresses the need for an efficient memory representation of the environment by providing a hybrid building-retrieval approach built on parameter-efficient VLMs that store low-level information about objects and their positions in a semantic graph, while retaining high-level descriptions of the observed scenes with a traditional retrieval-augmented architecture. EmbodiedLGR-Agent is evaluated on the popular NaVQA dataset, achieving state-of-the-art performance in inference and querying times for embodied agents, while retaining competitive accuracy on the global task relative to the current state-of-the-art approaches. Moreover, EmbodiedLGR-Agent was successfully deployed on a physical robot, showing practical utility in real-world contexts through human-robot interaction, while running the visual-language model and the building-retrieval pipeline locally.
tldr: The paper proposes EmbodiedLGR-Agent, a VLM-driven architecture for robotic agents that builds a hybrid semantic-spatial memory graph for efficient environment representation and retrieval, achieving state-of-the-art query times on NaVQA and demonstrating real-world deployment.
tldr_zh: 本文提出 EmbodiedLGR-Agent，一个用于机器人代理的 VLM 驱动架构，它构建了一个混合的语义-空间记忆图，用于高效的环境表示和检索，在 NaVQA 上实现了最先进的查询时间，并展示了在现实世界中的部署。
summary_zh: 随着应用于机器人领域的具身人工智能不断发展，对能够高效构建与检索记忆及观测信息的智能体需求日益增长。在复杂环境中运行的机器人必须建立记忆结构，通过利用当前操作环境的记忆表征来实现有效的人机交互。与机器人交互的人类通常期望具身智能体能够提供关于位置、事件或物体的信息，这要求智能体在类人推理时间内提供精确答案，以展现其响应能力。本文提出具身轻量图检索智能体（EmbodiedLGR-Agent），这是一种基于视觉语言模型驱动的智能体架构，能够构建机器人操作环境的密集高效表征。该架构通过提供一种混合构建-检索方法，直接解决了对环境进行高效记忆表征的需求：该方法基于参数高效的视觉语言模型，将物体及其位置的低层信息存储在语义图中，同时通过传统检索增强架构保留观测场景的高层描述。EmbodiedLGR-Agent在主流NaVQA数据集上进行了评估，在推理和查询时间方面达到具身智能体的最先进性能，同时在全任务精度上保持与当前最优方法的竞争力。此外，该智能体已成功部署于物理机器人，通过在本地运行视觉语言模型与构建-检索流程，在人机交互中展现了现实场景下的实用价值。

title: Unmasking the Illusion of Embodied Reasoning in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models report impressive success rates on standard robotic benchmarks, fueling optimism about general-purpose physical intelligence. However, recent evidence suggests a systematic misalignment between standard benchmark success and true embodied reasoning, raising the question of whether these high scores reflect genuine cognitive capability. To address this gap, we introduce BeTTER, a diagnostic Benchmark for Testing True Embodied Reasoning in robotic policies. BeTTER applies targeted causal interventions (e.g., spatial layout shifts, temporal extrapolation) while enforcing kinematic isolation to explicitly decouple high-level reasoning failures from low-level execution limits. Through systematic evaluation, we reveal that state-of-the-art VLAs catastrophically fail in dynamic scenarios, exhibiting severe lexical-kinematic shortcuts, behavioral inertia, and semantic feature collapse. Crucially, our mechanistic analysis traces these symptoms to fundamental architectural bottlenecks - such as capacity compression and myopic downsampling - which systematically degrade the model's foundational semantic representation. We demonstrate that highly static evaluation protocols effectively mask this degradation by allowing optimization to overfit to sensorimotor priors. Supported by real-world robotic validation, our findings confirm that this representational breakdown is not a simulation artifact, highlighting the critical need for future VLA paradigms to resolve the structural tension between high-frequency control and high-level reasoning.
tldr: The paper introduces a diagnostic benchmark for testing true embodied reasoning in VLA models, revealing severe failures due to architectural bottlenecks masked by static evaluation protocols.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个诊断性基准测试，用于测试VLA模型中的真正具身推理，揭示了由于静态评估协议所掩盖的架构瓶颈导致的严重失败。
summary_zh: 近期的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在标准机器人测试中取得了显著的成功率，这增强了对通用物理智能实现的乐观预期。然而，最新研究表明，标准测试的成功与真正的具身推理能力之间存在系统性错位，引发了这些高分是否反映真实认知能力的疑问。为填补这一空白，我们提出了BeTTER——一个用于测试机器人策略中真实具身推理能力的诊断性基准。BeTTER通过实施针对性因果干预（如空间布局变换、时间外推）并强化运动学隔离，明确将高层推理失效与底层执行局限进行解耦。通过系统化评估，我们发现当前最先进的VLA模型在动态场景中表现出灾难性失效，存在严重的词汇-运动学捷径、行为惯性及语义特征坍缩等问题。关键的是，我们的机理分析将这些问题追溯至根本性的架构瓶颈——如容量压缩与短视下采样——这些瓶颈系统性地损害了模型的基础语义表征能力。研究表明，高度静态的评估协议通过允许模型过度拟合感觉运动先验，有效掩盖了这种表征退化。通过真实世界机器人验证，我们的结果证实这种表征崩溃并非仿真伪影，凸显了未来VLA范式亟需解决高频控制与高层推理之间的结构性矛盾。

title: Can Explicit Physical Feasibility Benefit VLA Learning? An Empirical Study
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models map multimodal inputs directly to robot actions and are typically trained through large-scale imitation learning. While this paradigm has shown strong performance, prevailing VLA training procedures do not explicitly supervise hard physical constraints such as obstacle avoidance or kinematic feasibility. As a result, the geometric structure underlying physically feasible behavior must be inferred only implicitly from demonstrations. In this paper, we study whether introducing explicit feasibility supervision can provide effective structured guidance for VLA policies. We formulate a simple geometry-grounded feasibility objective and integrate it into the training stage of a diffusion-based VLA policy. To evaluate this idea systematically, we use obstacle-aware manipulation as a controlled probe of geometry-dependent physical feasibility. Empirical results show that augmenting VLA training with feasibility supervision improves both physical reliability and overall task performance, while also enhancing learning efficiency in the low-data regime. These findings indicate that explicit feasibility signals can effectively complement imitation-based VLA learning, highlighting their potential for developing more reliable VLA policies.
tldr: This paper studies the effect of adding explicit physical feasibility supervision (e.g., for obstacle avoidance) to the training of diffusion-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) robot policies, finding it improves reliability, task performance, and data efficiency.
tldr_zh: 本研究探讨了在基于扩散的视觉-语言-动作模型训练中，引入显式物理可行性监督（如避障）的效果，发现其能提升策略的可靠性、任务性能和低数据效率。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型将多模态输入直接映射至机器人动作，通常通过大规模模仿学习进行训练。尽管这一范式已展现出强劲性能，当前主流的视觉-语言-动作训练流程并未显式监督硬性物理约束（如避障或运动学可行性）。因此，物理可行行为背后的几何结构仅能通过示范数据隐式推断。本文研究引入显式可行性监督是否为视觉-语言-动作策略提供有效的结构化指导。我们提出一种基于几何的简易可行性目标，并将其整合至扩散式视觉-语言-动作策略的训练阶段。为系统评估该思想，我们以障碍物感知操作为实验场景，通过可控实验探究几何相关的物理可行性。实证结果表明，融合可行性监督的视觉-语言-动作训练能同时提升物理可靠性及整体任务性能，并在低数据量场景下增强学习效率。这些发现表明显式可行性信号可有效补充基于模仿的视觉-语言-动作学习，凸显了其在开发更可靠视觉-语言-动作策略方面的潜力。

title: SpaceDex: Generalizable Dexterous Grasping in Tiered Workspaces
summary: Generalizable grasping with high-degree-of-freedom (DoF) dexterous hands remains challenging in tiered workspaces, where occlusion, narrow clearances, and height-dependent constraints are substantially stronger than in open tabletop scenes. Most existing methods are evaluated in relatively unoccluded settings and typically do not explicitly model the distinct control requirements of arm navigation and hand articulation under spatial constraints. We present SpaceDex, a hierarchical framework for dexterous manipulation in constrained 3D environments. At the high level, a Vision-Language Model (VLM) planner parses user intent, reasons about occlusion and height relations across multiple camera views, and generates target bounding boxes for zero-shot segmentation and mask tracking. This stage provides structured spatial guidance for downstream control instead of relying on single-view target selection. At the low level, we introduce an arm-hand Feature Separation Network that decouples global trajectory control for the arm from geometry-aware grasp mode selection for the hand, reducing feature interference between reaching and grasping objectives. The controller further integrates multi-view perception, fingertip tactile sensing, and a small set of recovery demonstrations to improve robustness to partial observability and off-nominal contacts. In 100 real-world trials involving over 30 unseen objects across four categories, SpaceDex achieves a 63.0\% success rate, compared with 39.0\% for a strong tabletop baseline. These results indicate that combining hierarchical spatial planning with arm-hand representation decoupling improves dexterous grasping performance in spatially constrained environments.
tldr: SpaceDex is a hierarchical framework for dexterous grasping in constrained 3D environments, using a VLM planner for spatial reasoning and a decoupled arm-hand control network.
tldr_zh: SpaceDex是一个用于受限3D环境中灵巧抓取的分层框架，利用VLM规划器进行空间推理和解耦的手臂-手部控制网络。
summary_zh: 在层级化工作空间中，具有高自由度灵巧手爪的通用抓取任务依然面临巨大挑战，这类场景中的遮挡、狭窄间隙和高度相关约束远强于开放桌面环境。现有方法大多在相对无遮挡的场景中进行评估，通常未明确建模空间约束下机械臂导航与手部关节控制的差异化需求。本文提出SpaceDex——一种用于受限三维环境中灵巧操作的分层框架。高层级中，视觉语言模型规划器解析用户意图，通过多视角相机推理遮挡与高度关系，并生成目标边界框以实现零样本分割与掩码跟踪。该阶段为下游控制提供结构化空间引导，而非依赖单视角目标选择。低层级中，我们提出臂-手特征分离网络，将机械臂的全局轨迹控制与手部几何感知抓取模式选择解耦，从而降低接近目标与抓取目标间的特征干扰。控制器进一步融合多视角感知、指尖触觉传感及少量恢复演示，以提升对部分可观测性和非标接触的鲁棒性。在包含四大类别30余种未见物体的100次真实世界实验中，SpaceDex取得了63.0%的成功率，显著优于桌面基线方法的39.0%。这些结果表明，结合分层空间规划与臂-手表征解耦的策略能有效提升空间受限环境中的灵巧抓取性能。

title: StableIDM: Stabilizing Inverse Dynamics Model against Manipulator Truncation via Spatio-Temporal Refinement
summary: Inverse Dynamics Models (IDMs) map visual observations to low-level action commands, serving as central components for data labeling and policy execution in embodied AI. However, their performance degrades severely under manipulator truncation, a common failure mode that makes state recovery ill-posed and leads to unstable control. We present StableIDM, a spatio-temporal framework that refines features from visual inputs to stabilize action predictions under such partial observability. StableIDM integrates three complementary components: (1) auxiliary robot-centric masking to suppress background clutter, (2) Directional Feature Aggregation (DFA) for geometry-aware spatial reasoning, which extracts anisotropic features along directions inferred from the visible arm and (3) Temporal Dynamics Refinement (TDR) to smooth and correct predictions via motion continuity. Extensive evaluations validate our approach: StableIDM improves strict action accuracy by 12.1% under severe truncation on the AgiBot benchmark, and increases average task success by 9.7% in real-robot replay. Moreover, it boosts end-to-end grasp success by 11.5% when decoding video-generated plans, and improves downstream VLA real-robot success by 17.6% when functioning as an automatic annotator. These results demonstrate that StableIDM provides a robust and scalable backbone for both policy execution and data generation in embodied artificial intelligence.
tldr: StableIDM stabilizes inverse dynamics models for robot control under manipulator truncation using spatio-temporal feature refinement, improving task success and VLA performance.
tldr_zh: StableIDM通过时空特征细化，稳定了在机器人截断情况下的逆动力学模型，提高了任务成功率和视觉语言动作模型性能。
summary_zh: 逆动力学模型将视觉观测映射为底层动作指令，是具身人工智能中数据标注与策略执行的核心组件。然而在机械臂截断这一常见故障模式下，其性能会严重下降——该场景导致状态恢复问题不适定，进而引发控制失稳。本文提出 StableIDM，一种时空特征优化框架，通过精炼视觉输入特征在部分可观测条件下实现动作预测的稳定化。该框架融合了三个互补模块：（1）采用以机器人为中心的辅助掩码机制抑制背景干扰；（2）设计方向性特征聚合模块进行几何感知的空间推理，沿可见机械臂推断的方向提取各向异性特征；（3）通过时序动态优化模块，利用运动连续性对预测结果进行平滑校正。大量实验验证了方法的有效性：在 AgiBot 基准测试中，StableIDM 在严重截断场景下将严格动作准确率提升 12.1%；在真实机器人回放任务中平均成功率提高 9.7%。此外，当解码视频生成规划时，端到端抓取成功率提升 11.5%；作为自动标注器使用时，下游视觉语言动作模型的真实机器人任务成功率提升 17.6%。这些结果表明，StableIDM 为具身人工智能的策略执行与数据生成提供了鲁棒且可扩展的底层架构。

title: ST-$π$: Structured SpatioTemporal VLA for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have achieved great success on general robotic tasks, but still face challenges in fine-grained spatiotemporal manipulation. Typically, existing methods mainly embed spatiotemporal knowledge into visual and action representations, and directly perform a cross-modal mapping for step-level action prediction. However, such spatiotemporal reasoning remains largely implicit, making it difficult to handle multiple sequential behaviors with explicit spatiotemporal boundaries. In this work, we propose ST-$π$, a structured spatiotemporal VLA model for robotic manipulation. Our model is guided by two key designs: 1) Spatiotemporal VLM. We encode 4D observations and task instructions into latent spaces, and feed them into the LLM to generate a sequence of causally ordered chunk-level action prompts consisting of sub-tasks, spatial grounding and temporal grounding. 2) Spatiotemporal action expert. Conditioned on chunk-level action prompts, we design a structured dual-generator guidance to jointly model spatial dependencies and temporal causality, thus predicting step-level action parameters. Within this structured framework, the VLM explicitly plans global spatiotemporal behavior, and the action expert further refines local spatiotemporal control. In addition, we propose a real-world robotic dataset with structured spatiotemporal annotations for fine-tuning. Extensive experiments have been conducted to demonstrate the effectiveness of our model. Our code link: https://github.com/chuanhaoma/ST-pi.
tldr: This paper proposes ST-π, a structured Vision-Language-Action model for robotic manipulation that explicitly plans global spatiotemporal behavior via an LLM and refines local control with a dual-generator action expert, addressing fine-grained manipulation challenges.
tldr_zh: 本文提出ST-π，一种用于机器人操作的结构化视觉-语言-动作模型，它通过大语言模型显式规划全局时空行为，并使用双生成器动作专家细化局部控制，以解决细粒度操作挑战。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在通用机器人任务中已取得巨大成功，但在细粒度时空操作方面仍面临挑战。现有方法通常主要将时空知识嵌入到视觉和动作表示中，并直接通过跨模态映射进行步骤级动作预测。然而，这种时空推理在很大程度上仍是隐式的，难以处理具有明确时空边界的多序列行为。为此，我们提出了ST-$π$——一个用于机器人操作的结构化时空VLA模型。该模型的设计基于两个关键点：1）时空视觉语言模型。我们将四维观测与任务指令编码到潜在空间，并输入大型语言模型，以生成由子任务、空间定位与时间定位组成的因果有序片段级动作提示序列。2）时空动作专家。以片段级动作提示为条件，我们设计了结构化双生成器引导机制，共同建模空间依赖性与时间因果关系，从而预测步骤级动作参数。在此结构化框架中，视觉语言模型显式规划全局时空行为，动作专家则进一步细化局部时空控制。此外，我们提出了一个带有结构化时空标注的真实机器人数据集用于微调。大量实验验证了该模型的有效性。代码链接：https://github.com/chuanhaoma/ST-pi。

title: OFlow: Injecting Object-Aware Temporal Flow Matching for Robust Robotic Manipulation
summary: Robust robotic manipulation requires not only predicting how the scene evolves over time, but also recognizing task-relevant objects in complex scenes. However, existing VLA models face two limitations. They typically act only on the current frame, while future prediction and object-aware reasoning are often learned in separate latent spaces. We propose OFlow (injecting Object-Aware Temporal Flow Matching into VLAs), a framework that addresses both limitations by unifying temporal foresight and object-aware reasoning in a shared semantic latent space. Our method forecasts future latents with temporal flow matching, factorizes them into object-aware representations that emphasize physically relevant cues while filtering task-irrelevant variation, and conditions continuous action generation on these predictions. By integrating OFlow into VLA pipelines, our method enables more reliable control under distribution shifts. Extensive experiments across LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, MetaWorld, and SimplerEnv benchmarks and real-world tasks demonstrate that object-aware foresight consistently enhances robustness and success.
tldr: This paper introduces OFlow, a framework that integrates object-aware temporal flow matching into VLA models to unify future scene prediction and object reasoning for more robust robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文提出了OFlow框架，它将物体感知的时间流匹配整合到VLA模型中，统一了未来场景预测和物体推理，以实现更鲁棒的机器人操作。
summary_zh: 摘要：稳健的机器人操作不仅需要预测场景随时间的变化，还需要在复杂环境中识别任务相关的对象。然而，现有的视觉语言动作模型存在两大局限：它们通常仅基于当前帧进行操作，而未来预测与对象感知推理往往在分离的潜在空间中分别学习。我们提出了OFlow框架——将对象感知时序流匹配注入视觉语言动作模型，通过在共享语义潜在空间中统一时序预见与对象感知推理，以解决上述双重局限。该方法使用时序流匹配预测未来潜在状态，将其分解为对象感知表征，从而强化物理相关线索并过滤任务无关的噪声，并基于这些预测生成连续动作。通过将OFlow集成到视觉语言动作模型中，我们的方法在分布偏移条件下实现了更可靠的控制。在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、MetaWorld和SimplerEnv基准测试及实际任务中的广泛实验表明，对象感知预见能力持续提升了系统的鲁棒性与任务成功率。

title: Periodic Steady-State Control of a Handkerchief-Spinning Task Using a Parallel Anti-Parallelogram Tendon-driven Wrist
summary: Spinning flexible objects, exemplified by traditional Chinese handkerchief performances, demands periodic steady-state motions under nonlinear dynamics with frictional contacts and boundary constraints. To address these challenges, we first design an intuitive dexterous wrist based on a parallel anti-parallelogram tendon-driven structure, which achieves 90 degrees omnidirectional rotation with low inertia and decoupled roll-pitch sensing, and implement a high-low level hierarchical control scheme. We then develop a particle-spring model of the handkerchief for control-oriented abstraction and strategy evaluation. Hardware experiments validate this framework, achieving an unfolding ratio of approximately 99% and fingertip tracking error of RMSE = 2.88 mm in high-dynamic spinning. These results demonstrate that integrating control-oriented modeling with a task-tailored dexterous wrist enables robust rest-to-steady-state transitions and precise periodic manipulation of highly flexible objects. More visualizations: https://slowly1113.github.io/icra2026-handkerchief/
tldr: This paper presents a hardware-software framework for the precise periodic control of a highly flexible object (a handkerchief), using a custom tendon-driven dexterous wrist and a control-oriented particle-spring model. It validates the approach with hardware experiments, achieving robust rest-to-steady-state transitions and high-dynamic spinning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种软硬件框架，用于精确周期性控制高柔性物体（手帕），采用定制的腱驱动灵巧手腕和控制导向的粒子弹簧模型。通过硬件实验验证了该方法，实现了从静止到稳态的鲁棒转换和高动态旋转。
summary_zh: 旋转柔性物体（如传统中国手绢表演）需要在非线性动力学、摩擦接触及边界约束下实现周期性稳态运动。针对这些挑战，我们首先基于并联反平行四边形肌腱驱动结构设计了一种直观的灵巧手腕，其具备低惯量和解耦的滚转-俯仰传感能力，可实现90度全向旋转，并采用了高低层级分层控制方案。随后，我们构建了面向控制的手绢粒子弹簧模型，用于策略抽象与评估。硬件实验验证了该框架的有效性，在高动态旋转中实现了约99%的展开率，指尖跟踪误差均方根值为2.88毫米。结果表明，将面向控制的建模与任务定制的灵巧手腕相结合，能够实现从静止到稳态的鲁棒过渡，并对高柔性物体进行精确的周期性操控。更多可视化内容请访问：https://slowly1113.github.io/icra2026-handkerchief/

title: DART: Learning-Enhanced Model Predictive Control for Dual-Arm Non-Prehensile Manipulation
summary: What appears effortless to a human waiter remains a major challenge for robots. Manipulating objects nonprehensilely on a tray is inherently difficult, and the complexity is amplified in dual-arm settings. Such tasks are highly relevant to service robotics in domains such as hotels and hospitality, where robots must transport and reposition diverse objects with precision. We present DART, a novel dual-arm framework that integrates nonlinear Model Predictive Control (MPC) with an optimization-based impedance controller to achieve accurate object motion relative to a dynamically controlled tray. The framework systematically evaluates three complementary strategies for modeling tray-object dynamics as the state transition function within our MPC formulation: (i) a physics-based analytical model, (ii) an online regression based identification model that adapts in real-time, and (iii) a reinforcement learning-based dynamics model that generalizes across object properties. Our pipeline is validated in simulation with objects of varying mass, geometry, and friction coefficients. Extensive evaluations highlight the trade-offs among the three modeling strategies in terms of settling time, steady-state error, control effort, and generalization across objects. To the best of our knowledge, DART constitutes the first framework for non-prehensile dual-arm manipulation of objects on a tray. Project Link: https://dart-icra.github.io/dart/
tldr: DART is a dual-arm robot framework for non-prehensile tray manipulation, integrating MPC with an impedance controller. It evaluates three strategies for modeling tray-object dynamics (physics-based, online regression, and RL-based) for control and generalization.
tldr_zh: DART 是一种用于非抓取式托盘操作的双臂机器人框架，集成了 MPC 与基于优化的阻抗控制器，并评估了三种托盘-物体动力学建模策略（物理分析、在线回归、强化学习）以实现控制和泛化。
summary_zh: 对于人类服务员来说看似轻松的动作，对机器人而言仍然是一个重大挑战。在托盘上对物体进行非抓取式操作本身就存在固有困难，而在双臂协同场景下这种复杂性更是被进一步放大。此类任务在酒店服务等领域的服务机器人应用中至关重要，机器人需要精确地运输并重新定位各类物体。我们提出了DART——一种创新的双臂协同框架，该框架将非线性模型预测控制（MPC）与基于优化的阻抗控制器相结合，实现了物体相对于动态控制托盘的精确运动。该框架系统性地评估了三种互补的策略，用于构建MPC状态转移函数中的托盘-物体动力学模型：（1）基于物理原理的解析模型；（2）实时自适应调整的在线回归辨识模型；（3）能够泛化至不同物体属性的强化学习动力学模型。我们通过模拟环境验证了该框架在处理具有不同质量、几何形状和摩擦系数的物体时的性能。大量实验评估揭示了三种建模策略在稳定时间、稳态误差、控制效能以及跨物体泛化能力之间的权衡关系。据我们所知，DART是首个实现托盘物体非抓取式双臂协同操作的框架系统。项目链接：https://dart-icra.github.io/dart/

title: ReFineVLA: Multimodal Reasoning-Aware Generalist Robotic Policies via Teacher-Guided Fine-Tuning
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have gained much attention from the research community thanks to their strength in translating multimodal observations with linguistic instructions into desired robotic actions. Despite their advancements, VLAs often overlook explicit reasoning and learn the functional input-action mappings, omitting crucial logical steps, which are especially pronounced in interpretability and generalization for complex, long-horizon manipulation tasks. In this work, we propose ReFineVLA, a multimodal reasoning-aware framework that fine-tunes VLAs with teacher-guided reasons. We first augment robotic datasets with reasoning rationales generated by an expert teacher model, guiding VLA models to learn to reason about their actions. Then, we fine-tune pre-trained VLAs with the reasoning-enriched datasets with ReFineVLA, while maintaining the underlying generalization abilities and boosting reasoning capabilities. We also conduct attention map visualization to analyze the alignment among visual observation, linguistic prompts, and to-be-executed actions of ReFineVLA, reflecting the model is ability to focus on relevant tasks and actions. Through this additional step, we explore that ReFineVLA-trained models exhibit a meaningful agreement between vision-language and action domains, highlighting the enhanced multimodal understanding and generalization. Evaluated across a suite of simulated manipulation benchmarks on SimplerEnv with both WidowX and Google Robot tasks, ReFineVLA achieves state-of-the-art performance, in success rate over the second-best method on the both the WidowX benchmark and Google Robot Tasks.
tldr: The paper introduces ReFineVLA, a framework for fine-tuning Vision-Language-Action models by augmenting robotic datasets with reasoning rationales to improve their interpretability, generalization, and performance on long-horizon manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出ReFineVLA框架，通过用专家教师模型生成的推理原理增强机器人数据集，来微调视觉-语言-动作模型，以提高其在复杂长程操作任务中的可解释性、泛化能力和性能。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型因其能够将多模态观察与语言指令转化为期望的机器人动作而受到研究界的广泛关注。尽管这些模型取得了显著进展，但VLA模型往往忽略了显式推理过程，仅学习功能性的输入-动作映射关系，省略了关键的逻辑步骤。这一局限在复杂、长视野的操作任务中尤为突出，影响了模型的可解释性和泛化能力。本研究提出了ReFineVLA——一个多模态推理感知框架，通过教师引导的推理过程对VLA模型进行微调。我们首先利用专家教师模型生成推理依据，对机器人数据集进行增强，引导VLA模型学习动作背后的推理逻辑。随后，基于推理增强的数据集，采用ReFineVLA对预训练的VLA模型进行微调，在保持其基础泛化能力的同时提升推理性能。我们还通过注意力图可视化技术，分析了ReFineVLA在视觉观察、语言指令与待执行动作之间的对齐关系，证明了模型能够有效聚焦于相关任务和动作。通过这一额外步骤，我们发现经ReFineVLA训练的模型在视觉-语言与动作领域之间形成了有意义的一致性，凸显了其增强的多模态理解和泛化能力。在SimplerEnv仿真环境中，使用WidowX和Google机器人任务进行的一系列操作基准测试表明，ReFineVLA在WidowX基准测试和Google机器人任务中均实现了最先进的性能，其成功率优于次优方法。

title: AnchorRefine: Synergy-Manipulation Based on Trajectory Anchor and Residual Refinement for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Precision-critical manipulation requires both global trajectory organization and local execution correction, yet most vision-language-action (VLA) policies generate actions within a single unified space. This monolithic formulation forces macro-level transport and micro-level refinement to be optimized under the same objective, causing large motions to dominate learning while suppressing small but failure-critical corrective signals. In contrast, human manipulation is structured by global movement planning together with continuous local adjustment during execution. Motivated by this principle, we propose AnchorRefine, a hierarchical framework that factorizes VLA action modeling into trajectory anchor and residual refinement. The anchor planner predicts a coarse motion scaffold, while the refinement module corrects execution-level deviations to improve geometric and contact precision. We further introduce a decision-aware gripper refinement mechanism to better capture the discrete and boundary-sensitive nature of gripper control. Experiments on LIBERO, CALVIN, and real-robot tasks demonstrate that AnchorRefine consistently improves both regression-based and diffusion-based VLA backbones, yielding gains of up to 7.8% in simulation success rate and 18% in real-world success rate.
tldr: This paper proposes a hierarchical VLA framework called AnchorRefine for robot manipulation, which decomposes action generation into coarse trajectory planning and fine-grained corrective refinement, improving performance on benchmark and real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文提出了一个名为AnchorRefine的分层VLA框架，用于机器人操作，它将动作生成分解为粗略轨迹规划和细粒度校正细化，从而提高了在基准测试和真实世界任务中的性能。
summary_zh: 摘要：精度关键型操作任务既需要全局轨迹规划，又需要局部执行校正，然而当前多数视觉-语言-动作策略在单一统一空间中生成动作。这种整体化建模方式迫使宏观层级的移动任务与微观层级的调优动作在同一目标下进行优化，导致大幅度运动主导学习过程，而压制了细微却对失败关键的正向校正信号。相比之下，人类操作行为由全局运动规划与执行过程中的持续局部调整共同构成。受此启发，我们提出AnchorRefine分层框架，将视觉-语言-动作建模分解为轨迹锚点规划与残差精细化校正两个阶段。锚点规划器预测粗粒度运动框架，精细化模块则通过校正执行层偏差来提升几何精度与接触精度。我们还引入决策感知的夹爪精细化机制，以更好捕捉夹爪控制中离散且边界敏感的特性。在LIBERO、CALVIN数据集及真实机器人任务上的实验表明，AnchorRefine能持续提升基于回归和基于扩散的视觉-语言-动作基础模型，在仿真任务中成功率最高提升7.8%，在真实场景中成功率最高提升18%。

title: Test-Time Perturbation Learning with Delayed Feedback for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) achieve remarkable performance in sequential decision-making but remain fragile to subtle environmental shifts, such as small changes in object pose. We attribute this brittleness to trajectory overfitting, where VLAs over-attend to the spurious correlation between actions and entities, then reproduce memorized action patterns. We propose Perturbation learning with Delayed Feedback (PDF), a verifier-free test-time adaptation framework that improves decision performance without fine-tuning the base model. PDF mitigates the spurious correlation through uncertainty-based data augmentation and action voting, while an adaptive scheduler allocates augmentation budgets to balance performance and efficiency. To further improve stability, PDF learns a lightweight perturbation module that retrospectively adjusts action logits guided by delayed feedback, correcting overconfidence issue. Experiments on LIBERO (+7.4\% success rate) and Atari (+10.3 human normalized score) demonstrate consistent gains of PDF in task success over vanilla VLA and VLA with test-time adaptation, establishing a practical path toward reliable test-time adaptation in multimodal decision-making agents. The code is available at \href{https://github.com/zhoujiahuan1991/CVPR2026-PDF}{https://github.com/zhoujiahuan1991/CVPR2026-PDF}.
tldr: PDF proposes a test-time adaptation method for Vision-Language-Action models, using uncertainty-based data augmentation and a lightweight perturbation module with delayed feedback to improve robustness to environmental shifts, validated on robotic (LIBERO) and Atari benchmarks.
tldr_zh: PDF为视觉-语言-动作模型提出了一种测试时适应方法，通过基于不确定性的数据增强和带有延迟反馈的轻量级扰动模块来提高对环境变化的鲁棒性，并在机器人（LIBERO）和Atari基准上得到验证。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）在序列决策任务中表现优异，但面对环境中的细微变化（例如物体姿态的轻微改变）时仍显得脆弱。我们将这种脆弱性归因于轨迹过拟合，即VLA过度关注动作与实体之间的虚假关联，从而机械复现记忆中的动作模式。本文提出延迟反馈扰动学习框架，一种无需验证器的测试时自适应方法，可在不微调基础模型的情况下提升决策性能。该框架通过基于不确定性的数据增强和动作投票机制削弱虚假关联，并采用自适应调度器分配增强预算以平衡性能与效率。为进一步提升稳定性，该方法学习一个轻量级扰动模块，在延迟反馈引导下回顾性调整动作对数分布，修正过度自信问题。在LIBERO（成功率提升7.4%）和Atari（人类标准化得分提升10.3%）数据集上的实验表明，该方法相较于原始VLA及具备测试时自适应的VLA均取得持续性能增益，为多模态决策智能体实现可靠的测试时自适应提供了可行路径。代码已开源。

title: E3VS-Bench: A Benchmark for Viewpoint-Dependent Active Perception in 3D Gaussian Splatting Scenes
summary: Visual search in 3D environments requires embodied agents to actively explore their surroundings and acquire task-relevant evidence. However, existing visual search and embodied AI benchmarks, including EQA, typically rely on static observations or constrained egocentric motion, and thus do not explicitly evaluate fine-grained viewpoint-dependent phenomena that arise under unrestricted 5-DoF viewpoint control in real-world 3D environments, such as visibility changes caused by vertical viewpoint shifts, revealing contents inside containers, and disambiguating object attributes that are only observable from specific angles. To address this limitation, we introduce {E3VS-Bench}, a benchmark for embodied 3D visual search where agents must control their viewpoints in 5-DoF to gather viewpoint-dependent evidence for question answering. E3VS-Bench consists of 99 high-fidelity 3D scenes reconstructed using 3D Gaussian Splatting and 2,014 question-driven episodes. 3D Gaussian Splatting enables photorealistic free-viewpoint rendering that preserves fine-grained visual details (e.g., small text and subtle attributes) often degraded in mesh-based simulators, thereby allowing the construction of questions that cannot be answered from a single view and instead require active inspection across viewpoints in 5-DoF. We evaluate multiple state-of-the-art VLMs and compare their performance with humans. Despite strong 2D reasoning ability, all models exhibit a substantial gap from humans, highlighting limitations in active perception and coherent viewpoint planning specifically under full 5-DoF viewpoint changes.
tldr: The paper introduces E3VS-Bench, a benchmark for embodied 3D visual search in 5-DoF, testing active perception and viewpoint planning of agents in photorealistic 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了E3VS-Bench，一个用于5自由度具身3D视觉搜索的基准，在逼真的3D高斯泼溅场景中测试智能体的主动感知和视角规划能力。
summary_zh: 在三维环境中的视觉搜索任务要求具身智能体主动探索周围环境并获取任务相关证据。然而，现有视觉搜索与具身人工智能基准（包括EQA）通常依赖静态观测或受限的以自我为中心的运动模式，未能明确评估现实三维环境中在无限制五自由度视角控制下产生的细粒度视角依赖现象，例如垂直视角移动导致的可见性变化、容器内部内容的显露，以及仅能从特定角度观察才能区分的物体属性。为解决这一局限，我们提出了{E3VS-Bench}——一个具身三维视觉搜索基准，要求智能体通过五自由度视角控制来收集视角依赖证据以回答问题。E3VS-Bench包含99个使用3D高斯泼溅技术重建的高保真三维场景及2,014个问题驱动的任务片段。3D高斯泼溅技术能够实现保留细粒度视觉细节（如小尺寸文字和细微属性）的照片级逼真自由视角渲染，这些细节在基于网格的模拟器中通常存在退化现象，从而使得我们能够构建无法通过单一视角解答、而需要五自由度多视角主动探查的问题。我们评估了多种前沿视觉语言模型，并将其性能与人类表现进行对比。尽管这些模型具备强大的二维推理能力，但在完整的五自由度视角变化条件下，所有模型在主动感知与连贯视角规划方面仍与人类表现存在显著差距。

title: DAG-STL: A Hierarchical Framework for Zero-Shot Trajectory Planning under Signal Temporal Logic Specifications
summary: Signal Temporal Logic (STL) is a powerful language for specifying temporally structured robotic tasks. Planning executable trajectories under STL constraints remains difficult when system dynamics and environment structure are not analytically available. Existing methods typically either assume explicit models or learn task-specific behaviors, limiting zero-shot generalization to unseen STL tasks. In this work, we study offline STL planning under unknown dynamics using only task-agnostic trajectory data. Our central design philosophy is to separate logical reasoning from trajectory realization. We instantiate this idea in DAG-STL, a hierarchical framework that converts long-horizon STL planning into three stages. It first decomposes an STL formula into reachability and invariance progress conditions linked by shared timing constraints. It then allocates timed waypoints using learned reachability-time estimates. Finally, it synthesizes trajectories between these waypoints with a diffusion-based generator. This decomposition--allocation--generation pipeline reduces global planning to shorter, better-supported subproblems. To bridge the gap between planning-level correctness and execution-level feasibility, we further introduce a rollout-free dynamic consistency metric, an anytime refinement search procedure for improving multiple allocation hypotheses under finite budgets, and a hierarchical online replanning mechanism for execution-time recovery. Experiments in Maze2D, OGBench AntMaze, and the Cube domain show that DAG-STL substantially outperforms direct robustness-guided diffusion on complex long-horizon STL tasks and generalizes across navigation and manipulation settings. In a custom environment with an optimization-based reference, DAG-STL recovers most model-solvable tasks while retaining a clear computational advantage over direct optimization based on the explicit system model.
tldr: This paper presents DAG-STL, a hierarchical framework for zero-shot robotic trajectory planning under Signal Temporal Logic specifications using a decomposition-allocation-generation pipeline that works with unknown dynamics and generalizes across navigation and manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了DAG-STL，一个用于在未知动力学下，根据信号时序逻辑规范进行零样本机器人轨迹规划的层次化框架，通过分解-分配-生成的流程，在导航和操作任务中均能实现泛化。
summary_zh: 信号时序逻辑（STL）是一种用于描述具有时间结构的机器人任务的强大语言。当系统动力学和环境结构无法通过解析方法获得时，在STL约束下规划可执行轨迹仍然具有挑战性。现有方法通常假设存在显式模型或学习特定任务的行为，限制了其在未见过STL任务上的零样本泛化能力。本文研究中，我们仅利用任务无关的轨迹数据，在未知动力学条件下进行离线STL规划。我们的核心设计理念是将逻辑推理与轨迹实现分离，并在分层框架DAG-STL中实现这一理念。该框架将长时程STL规划转化为三个阶段：首先，将STL公式分解为通过共享时序约束连接的可达性与不变性进度条件；接着，利用学习到的可达时间估计分配时序航点；最后，通过基于扩散的生成器合成这些航点之间的轨迹。这种分解—分配—生成的流程将全局规划简化为更短、更易处理的子问题。为弥合规划层面的正确性与执行层面可行性之间的差距，我们进一步引入了免展开的动态一致性度量、在有限预算下改进多分配假设的随时优化搜索过程，以及用于执行时恢复的分层在线重规划机制。在Maze2D、OGBench AntMaze和Cube领域的实验表明，DAG-STL在复杂长时程STL任务上显著优于直接基于鲁棒性引导的扩散方法，并能在导航和操控场景中实现跨领域泛化。在基于优化参考的定制环境中，DAG-STL能够恢复大部分模型可解任务，同时相比基于显式系统模型的直接优化方法保持了显著的计算优势。

title: Enhancing Glass Surface Reconstruction via Depth Prior for Robot Navigation
summary: Indoor robot navigation is often compromised by glass surfaces, which severely corrupt depth sensor measurements. While foundation models like Depth Anything 3 provide excellent geometric priors, they lack an absolute metric scale. We propose a training-free framework that leverages depth foundation models as a structural prior, employing a robust local RANSAC-based alignment to fuse it with raw sensor depth. This naturally avoids contamination from erroneous glass measurements and recovers an accurate metric scale. Furthermore, we introduce \ti{GlassRecon}, a novel RGB-D dataset with geometrically derived ground truth for glass regions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, especially under severe sensor depth corruption. The dataset and related code will be released at https://github.com/jarvisyjw/GlassRecon.
tldr: This paper proposes a training-free method to enhance robot navigation by reconstructing glass surfaces, using a depth foundation model as a prior and RANSAC for alignment, and introduces a new dataset for evaluation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种无需训练的方法来增强机器人导航，通过将深度基础模型作为先验，并使用RANSAC进行对齐来重建玻璃表面，并引入了一个新的数据集进行评估。
summary_zh: 室内机器人导航常因玻璃表面而受到干扰，这些表面会严重破坏深度传感器的测量精度。虽然基础模型（如Depth Anything 3）能够提供出色的几何先验信息，但缺乏绝对度量尺度。为此，我们提出了一种无需训练的新框架，该框架利用深度基础模型作为结构先验，并采用基于鲁棒局部RANSAC的配准方法将其与原始传感器深度数据融合。该方法自然避免了由错误玻璃测量引起的污染，并恢复了准确的度量尺度。此外，我们推出了新型RGB-D数据集——GlassRecon，该数据集包含从几何角度推导出的玻璃区域真实标注。大量实验表明，我们的方法在各项测试中均显著优于现有先进基准模型，尤其是在传感器深度数据严重受损的情况下。该数据集及相关代码将于https://github.com/jarvisyjw/GlassRecon公开。

title: Relative State Estimation using Event-Based Propeller Sensing
summary: Autonomous swarms of multi-Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) system requires an accurate and fast relative state estimation. Although monocular frame-based camera methods perform well in ideal conditions, they are slow, suffer scale ambiguity, and often struggle in visually challenging conditions. The advent of event cameras addresses these challenging tasks by providing low latency, high dynamic range, and microsecond-level temporal resolution. This paper proposes a framework for relative state estimation for quadrotors using event-based propeller sensing. The propellers in the event stream are tracked by detection to extract the region-of-interests. The event streams in these regions are processed in temporal chunks to estimate per-propeller frequencies. These frequency measurements drive a kinematic state estimation module as a thrust input, while camera-derived position measurements provide the update step. Additionally, we use geometric primitives derived from event streams to estimate the orientation of the quadrotor by fitting an ellipse over a propeller and backprojecting it to recover body-frame tilt-axis. The existing event-based approaches for quadrotor state estimation use the propeller frequency in simulated flight sequences. Our approach estimates the propeller frequency under 3% error on a test dataset of five real-world outdoor flight sequences, providing a method for decentralized relative localization for multi-robot systems using event camera.
tldr: This paper presents a framework for relative state estimation between quadrotor UAVs using event cameras to sense propeller motion, enabling decentralized localization for multi-robot systems.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种利用事件相机感知螺旋桨运动进行四旋翼无人机相对状态估计的框架，旨在实现多机器人系统的去中心化定位。
summary_zh: 多无人机（UAV）自主集群系统需要准确且快速的相对状态估计。尽管基于单目帧的摄像头方法在理想条件下表现良好，但存在速度较慢、尺度模糊性以及在视觉挑战性环境下性能受限等问题。事件摄像头的出现通过提供低延迟、高动态范围和微秒级时间分辨率，有效应对了这些挑战任务。本文提出一种基于事件流螺旋桨感知的四旋翼无人机相对状态估计框架。通过检测跟踪事件流中的螺旋桨，提取出感兴趣区域。对这些区域的事件流进行时间分块处理，以估计各螺旋桨的转速。这些频率测量值作为推力输入驱动运动学状态估计模块，而基于摄像头的位置测量值则提供更新步骤。此外，我们利用从事件流中提取的几何基元，通过对螺旋桨轮廓拟合椭圆并将其反投影至机体坐标系以恢复倾斜轴，从而估计四旋翼无人机的姿态。现有基于事件的四旋翼状态估计方法仅在模拟飞行序列中使用螺旋桨频率。本文方法在包含五段真实户外飞行序列的测试数据集中，实现了低于3%误差的螺旋桨频率估计，为使用事件摄像头的多机器人系统提供了一种去中心化的相对定位方法。

title: COFFAIL: A Dataset of Successful and Anomalous Robot Skill Executions in the Context of Coffee Preparation
summary: In the context of robot learning for manipulation, curated datasets are an important resource for advancing the state of the art; however, available datasets typically only include successful executions or are focused on one particular type of skill. In this short paper, we briefly describe a dataset of various skills performed in the context of coffee preparation. The dataset, which we call COFFAIL, includes both successful and anomalous skill execution episodes collected with a physical robot in a kitchen environment, a couple of which are performed with bimanual manipulation. In addition to describing the data collection setup and the collected data, the paper illustrates the use of the data in COFFAIL to learn a robot policy using imitation learning.
tldr: The paper introduces COFFAIL, a dataset of successful and anomalous robot manipulation episodes for coffee preparation, and demonstrates its use for learning policies via imitation learning.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了COFFAIL数据集，包含咖啡制作任务中成功和异常的机器人操作记录，并展示了如何利用该数据集通过模仿学习训练机器人策略。
summary_zh: 在机器人操作学习的背景下，经过精心筛选的数据集是推动技术前沿发展的重要资源；然而，现有数据集通常仅包含成功执行的数据，或专注于特定类型的技能。本文简要介绍一个围绕咖啡制作场景收集的多样化技能数据集。该数据集被命名为COFFAIL，包含在厨房环境中由实体机器人执行的成功及异常技能演示片段，其中部分片段采用了双手协同操作方式。除了描述数据收集设置和收集到的数据内容，本文还展示了如何利用COFFAIL数据集通过模仿学习来训练机器人策略。

title: Locomotion of an Elastic Snake Robot via Natural Dynamics
summary: Nature suggests that exploiting the elasticities and natural dynamics of robotic systems could increase their locomotion efficiency. Prior work on elastic snake robots supports this hypothesis, but has not fully exploited the nonlinear dynamic behavior of the systems. Recent advances in eigenmanifold theory enable a better characterization of the natural dynamics in complex nonlinear systems. This letter investigates if and how the nonlinear natural dynamics of a kinematic elastic snake robot can be used to design efficient gaits. Two types of gaits based on natural dynamics are presented and compared to a state-of-the-art approach using dynamics simulations. The results reveal that a gait generated by switching between two nonlinear normal modes does not improve the locomotion efficiency of the robot. In contrast, gaits based on non-brake periodic trajectories (non-brake orbits) are perfectly efficient in the energy-conservative case. Further simulations with friction reveal that, in a more realistic scenario, non-brake orbit gaits achieve higher efficiency compared to the baseline gait on the rigid system. Overall, the investigation offers promising insights into the design of gaits based on natural dynamics, fostering further research.
tldr: This paper investigates using the nonlinear natural dynamics of an elastic snake robot to design efficient locomotion gaits, comparing eigenmanifold-based gaits to a baseline and finding non-brake periodic trajectories to be more efficient in simulations with friction.
tldr_zh: 本研究探索利用弹性蛇形机器人的非线性自然动力学设计高效步态，比较了基于特征流形的步态与基线方法，发现在含摩擦的模拟中，非制动周期轨迹步态效率更高。
summary_zh: 自然界表明，利用机器人系统的弹性与自然动力学特性可以提升其运动效率。先前关于弹性蛇形机器人的研究支持了这一假设，但尚未充分挖掘系统的非线性动态行为。特征流形理论的最新进展使得我们能够更好地描述复杂非线性系统中的自然动力学特性。本文旨在探究能否以及如何利用运动学弹性蛇形机器人的非线性自然动力学来设计高效步态。研究提出了两种基于自然动力学的步态，并通过动力学仿真将其与先进方法进行对比。结果显示，通过在两种非线性正态模式间切换生成的步态并未提高机器人的运动效率。相反，基于非制动周期性轨迹（非制动轨道）的步态在能量守恒情况下实现了完全高效。进一步的含摩擦仿真表明，在更现实的场景中，非制动轨道步态相较于刚性系统的基准步态实现了更高的效率。总体而言，这项研究为基于自然动力学的步态设计提供了有价值的见解，并推动了相关领域的深入研究。

title: SYMBOLIZER: Symbolic Model-free Task Planning with VLMs
summary: Traditional Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) systems depend on physics models for motion planning and discrete symbolic models for task planning. Although physics model are often available, symbolic models (consisting of symbolic state interpretation and action models) must be meticulously handcrafted or learned from labeled data. This process is both resource-intensive and constrains the solution to the specific domain, limiting scalability and adaptability. On the other hand, Visual Language Models (VLMs) show desirable zero-shot visual understanding (due to their extensive training on heterogeneous data), but still achieve limited planning capabilities. Therefore, integrating VLMs with classical planning for long-horizon reasoning in TAMP problems offers high potential. Recent works in this direction still lack generality and depend on handcrafted, task-specific solutions, e.g. describing all possible objects in advance, or using symbolic action models. We propose a framework that generalizes well to unseen problem instances. The method requires only lifted predicates describing relations among objects and uses VLMs to ground them from images to obtain the symbolic state. Planning is performed with domain-independent heuristic search using goal-count and width-based heuristics, without need for action models. Symbolic search over VLM-grounded state-space outperforms direct VLM-based planning and performs on par with approaches that use a VLM-derived heuristic. This shows that domain-independent search can effectively solve problems across domains with large combinatorial state spaces. We extensively evaluate on extensively evaluate our method and achieve state-of-the-art results on the ProDG and ViPlan benchmarks.
tldr: The paper proposes a framework that uses Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to ground symbolic states from images, enabling domain-independent symbolic task planning for Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) problems without requiring handcrafted action models.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种框架，利用视觉语言模型从图像中抽取符号化状态，结合经典的启发式搜索，为任务与运动规划问题实现无需人工动作模型的、领域无关的符号任务规划。
summary_zh: 传统任务与运动规划系统依赖于物理模型进行运动规划，并采用离散符号模型进行任务规划。虽然物理模型通常易于获取，但符号模型（包括符号状态解释与动作模型）往往需要人工精心设计或从标注数据中学习。这一过程不仅资源消耗大，还将解决方案限制在特定领域，影响了系统的可扩展性和适应性。另一方面，视觉语言模型展现出优秀的零样本视觉理解能力（得益于其基于异构数据的广泛训练），但其规划能力仍较为有限。因此，将视觉语言模型与经典规划方法相结合，用于处理任务与运动规划中的长时序推理问题，具有巨大潜力。当前该方向的研究仍缺乏通用性，且依赖于人工设计的特定任务解决方案，例如预先描述所有可能对象，或使用符号动作模型。本文提出了一种能够泛化至未见问题实例的框架。该方法仅需描述对象间关系的提升谓词，并利用视觉语言模型从图像中实现谓词的具体化以获取符号状态。规划过程采用与领域无关的启发式搜索（基于目标计数和宽度启发式），无需动作模型。基于视觉语言模型符号状态空间的符号搜索方法，其性能优于直接基于视觉语言模型的规划方案，并与采用视觉语言模型启发式的方法表现相当。这表明领域无关搜索能够有效解决具有大规模组合状态空间的跨领域问题。我们通过大量实验评估了所提方法，并在ProDG和ViPlan基准测试中取得了最先进的性能表现。

title: Memory Centric Power Allocation for Multi-Agent Embodied Question Answering
summary: This paper considers multi-agent embodied question answering (MA-EQA), which aims to query robot teams on what they have seen over a long horizon. In contrast to existing edge resource management methods that emphasize sensing, communication, or computation performance metrics, MA-EQA emphasizes the memory qualities. To cope with this paradigm shift, we propose a quality of memory (QoM) model based on generative adversarial exam (GAE), which leverages forward simulation to assess memory retrieval and uses the resulting exam scores to compute QoM values. Then we propose memory centric power allocation (MCPA), which maximizes the QoM function under communication resource constraints. Through asymptotic analysis, it is found that the transmit powers are proportional to the GAE error probability, thus prioritizing towards high-QoM robots. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MCPA achieves significant improvements over extensive benchmarks in terms of diverse metrics in various scenarios.
tldr: Proposes a memory-centric power allocation (MCPA) method for multi-agent embodied question answering (MA-EQA), introducing a Quality of Memory (QoM) model to optimize communication resource allocation and improve team performance on long-horizon queries.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种用于多智能体具身问答（MA-EQA）的以记忆为中心的功率分配方法，通过引入记忆质量模型来优化通信资源分配，提升团队在长期视野查询中的表现。
summary_zh: 本文研究了多智能体具身问答（MA-EQA）问题，其目标是对长时间运行的机器人团队进行所见场景的查询。与现有强调感知、通信或计算性能指标的边缘资源管理方法不同，MA-EQA更关注记忆质量特性。为应对这一范式转变，我们提出一种基于生成对抗式测试（GAE）的记忆质量（QoM）模型，该模型通过前向仿真评估记忆检索能力，并利用测试结果计算QoM值。进而提出以记忆为中心的功率分配（MCPA）方案，该方案在通信资源约束下最大化QoM函数。渐近分析表明，发射功率与GAE错误概率成正比，从而实现对高QoM机器人的优先级分配。大量实验表明，在不同场景的多样化评估指标下，MCPA方案较多种基准方法均取得显著性能提升。

title: A Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability-Guided Search Framework for Efficient and Safe Indoor Planar Robot Navigation
summary: Autonomous navigation requires planning to reach a goal safely and efficiently in complex and potentially dynamic environments. Graph search-based algorithms are widely adopted due to their generality and theoretical guarantees when equipped with admissible heuristics. However, the computational complexity of graph search grows rapidly with the dimensionality of the search space, often making real-time planning in dynamic environments intractable. In this paper, we combine offline Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) reachability with online graph search to leverage the complementary strengths of both. Precomputed HJ value functions, used as informative heuristics and proactive safety constraints, amortize online computation of the graph search process. At the same time, graph search enables reachability-based reasoning to be incorporated into online planning, overcoming the long-standing challenge of HJ reachability requiring full knowledge of the environment. Extensive simulation studies and real-world experiments demonstrate that the proposed approach consistently outperforms baseline methods in terms of planning efficiency and navigation safety, in environments with and without human presence.
tldr: This paper presents a hybrid planning method combining offline Hamilton-Jacobi reachability precomputation with online graph search to improve the efficiency and safety of indoor planar robot navigation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种混合规划方法，结合离线预计算的汉密尔顿-雅可比可达性与在线图搜索，以提高室内平面机器人导航的效率和安全性。
summary_zh: 自主导航需要在复杂且可能存在动态变化的环境中规划出一条安全高效的路径以抵达目标。基于图搜索的算法因其通用性及在配备可采纳启发式算法时具备的理论保证而被广泛采用。然而，图搜索的计算复杂度随搜索空间维度迅速增长，常导致动态环境中的实时规划难以实现。本文结合离线汉密尔顿-雅可比可达性分析与在线图搜索，以发挥两者互补的优势。预计算的汉密尔顿-雅可比值函数作为信息型启发式函数和主动安全约束，可分摊图搜索过程的在线计算量。同时，图搜索使得基于可达性的推理能够融入在线规划，从而克服了汉密尔顿-雅可比可达性分析长期需要完全掌握环境信息这一难题。大量的仿真实验与真实场景测试表明，无论环境中是否有人类存在，所提出的方法在规划效率和导航安全性方面均持续优于基准方法。

title: Bounded Ratio Reinforcement Learning
summary: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) has become the predominant algorithm for on-policy reinforcement learning due to its scalability and empirical robustness across domains. However, there is a significant disconnect between the underlying foundations of trust region methods and the heuristic clipped objective used in PPO. In this paper, we bridge this gap by introducing the Bounded Ratio Reinforcement Learning (BRRL) framework. We formulate a novel regularized and constrained policy optimization problem and derive its analytical optimal solution. We prove that this solution ensures monotonic performance improvement. To handle parameterized policy classes, we develop a policy optimization algorithm called Bounded Policy Optimization (BPO) that minimizes an advantage-weighted divergence between the policy and the analytic optimal solution from BRRL. We further establish a lower bound on the expected performance of the resulting policy in terms of the BPO loss function. Notably, our framework also provides a new theoretical lens to interpret the success of the PPO loss, and connects trust region policy optimization and the Cross-Entropy Method (CEM). We additionally extend BPO to Group-relative BPO (GBPO) for LLM fine-tuning. Empirical evaluations of BPO across MuJoCo, Atari, and complex IsaacLab environments (e.g., Humanoid locomotion), and of GBPO for LLM fine-tuning tasks, demonstrate that BPO and GBPO generally match or outperform PPO and GRPO in stability and final performance.
tldr: Introduces Bounded Ratio Reinforcement Learning (BRRL), a new policy optimization framework with a proven monotonic improvement guarantee. It also presents Bounded Policy Optimization (BPO) and its group-relative variant GBPO for LLM fine-tuning, showing competitive or superior results to PPO/GRPO on MuJoCo, Atari, and robotics benchmarks like IsaacLab.
tldr_zh: 提出有界比率强化学习（BRRL）新框架，建立了具有理论保证的性能单调提升策略优化方法，并衍生了BPO算法及其用于大语言模型微调的变体GBPO。在MuJoCo、Atari和IsaacLab等机器人仿真环境中验证，性能稳定且优于PPO基准。
summary_zh: 近端策略优化（PPO）因其可扩展性及在不同领域的实证鲁棒性，已成为当前主流的同策略强化学习算法。然而，信任域方法的理论基础与PPO中使用的启发式裁剪目标函数之间存在显著脱节。本文通过引入有界比率强化学习框架，弥补了这一理论差距。我们构建了一个新型正则化约束策略优化问题，并推导出其解析最优解。我们证明该解能够确保策略性能的单调提升。为处理参数化策略类，我们开发了一种名为有界策略优化的策略优化算法，该算法通过最小化策略与BRRL解析最优解之间的优势加权散度来优化策略。我们进一步基于BPO损失函数建立了所得策略期望性能的下界。值得注意的是，本框架还为解读PPO损失函数的成功提供了新的理论视角，并在信任域策略优化与交叉熵方法之间建立了理论联系。我们还进一步将BPO扩展为适用于大语言模型微调的组相对有界策略优化算法。在MuJoCo、Atari和复杂IsaacLab环境（如人形机器人运动控制）中对BPO的实证评估，以及在大语言模型微调任务中对GBPO的测试表明，BPO与GBPO在稳定性与最终性能方面普遍达到或超越了PPO与GRPO的表现。

title: MultiWorld: Scalable Multi-Agent Multi-View Video World Models
summary: Video world models have achieved remarkable success in simulating environmental dynamics in response to actions by users or agents. They are modeled as action-conditioned video generation models that take historical frames and current actions as input to predict future frames. Yet, most existing approaches are limited to single-agent scenarios and fail to capture the complex interactions inherent in real-world multi-agent systems. We present \textbf{MultiWorld}, a unified framework for multi-agent multi-view world modeling that enables accurate control of multiple agents while maintaining multi-view consistency. We introduce the Multi-Agent Condition Module to achieve precise multi-agent controllability, and the Global State Encoder to ensure coherent observations across different views. MultiWorld supports flexible scaling of agent and view counts, and synthesizes different views in parallel for high efficiency. Experiments on multi-player game environments and multi-robot manipulation tasks demonstrate that MultiWorld outperforms baselines in video fidelity, action-following ability, and multi-view consistency. Project page: https://multi-world.github.io/
tldr: Introduces MultiWorld, a framework for multi-agent multi-view video world models that achieves precise control and consistency across agents and views, validated on multi-robot manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出了MultiWorld，一个多智能体多视角视频世界模型框架，能够在多智能体操作中实现精确控制和视图一致性，并在多机器人操控任务上进行了验证。
summary_zh: 视频世界模型在模拟由用户或智能体动作引发的环境动态方面取得了显著成就。这些模型通常被构建为动作条件视频生成模型，它们接收历史帧和当前动作作为输入，以预测未来帧。然而，现有方法大多局限于单智能体场景，无法捕捉现实世界中多智能体系统固有的复杂交互。本文提出\textbf{MultiWorld}，一个统一的多智能体多视角世界建模框架，能够在保持多视角一致性的同时实现对多个智能体的精确控制。我们引入了多智能体条件模块以实现精确的多智能体可控性，并通过全局状态编码器确保不同视角间观测的连贯性。MultiWorld支持智能体数量和视角数量的灵活扩展，并能够并行合成不同视角以实现高效生成。在多玩家游戏环境和多机器人操作任务上的实验表明，MultiWorld在视频保真度、动作跟随能力和多视角一致性方面均优于基线方法。项目页面：https://multi-world.github.io/

title: Instruction-as-State: Environment-Guided and State-Conditioned Semantic Understanding for Embodied Navigation
summary: Vision-and-Language Navigation requires agents to follow natural-language instructions in visually changing environments. A central challenge is the dynamic entanglement between language and observations: the meaning of instruction shifts as the agent's field of view and spatial context evolve. However, many existing models encode the instruction as a static global representation, limiting their ability to adapt instruction meaning to the current visual context. We therefore model instruction understanding as an Instruction-as-State variable: a decision-relevant, token-level instruction state that evolves step by step conditioned on the agent's perceptual state, where the perceptual state denotes the observation-grounded navigation context at each step. To realize this principle, we introduce State-Entangled Environment-Guided Instruction Understanding (S-EGIU), a coarse-to-fine framework for state-conditioned segment activation and token-level semantic refinement. At the coarse level, S-EGIU activates the instruction segment whose semantics align with the current observation. At the fine level, it refines the activated segment through observation-guided token grounding and contextual modeling, sharpening its internal semantics under the current observation. Together, these stages maintain an instruction state that is continuously updated according to the agent's perceptual state during navigation. S-EGIU delivers strong performance on several key metrics, including a +2.68% SPL gain on REVERIE Test Unseen, and demonstrates consistent efficiency gains across multiple VLN benchmarks, underscoring the value of dynamic instruction--perception entanglement.
tldr: This paper proposes an 'Instruction-as-State' framework (S-EGIU) for Vision-and-Language Navigation, which dynamically updates the semantic understanding of a navigation instruction step-by-step based on the agent's current perceptual state to improve performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种“指令即状态”框架（S-EGIU），用于视觉语言导航任务，该框架基于智能体当前感知状态逐步动态更新导航指令的语义理解，从而提升性能。
summary_zh: 视觉语言导航任务要求智能体在视觉动态变化的环境中遵循自然语言指令行进。其核心挑战在于语言与观测信息之间的动态耦合关系：随着智能体视野与空间环境的变化，指令的语义含义也随之改变。然而，现有模型大多将指令编码为静态全局表示，限制了其依据当前视觉语境调整指令理解的能力。为此，我们将指令理解建模为“指令即状态”变量：一种与决策相关、以细粒度词元表征的指令状态，该状态会根据智能体的感知状态逐步演化——其中感知状态表示智能体在每一步基于观测确立的导航情境。为实现这一理念，我们提出“状态耦合的环境引导指令理解”框架，这是一种从粗到细的分层处理机制，通过状态条件化片段激活与词元级语义精化实现指令理解。在粗粒度层面，该框架激活与当前观测语义对齐的指令片段；在细粒度层面，通过观测引导的词元定位与上下文建模对激活片段进行语义精化，使其内部语义在当前观测条件下更为精准。这两个层级共同维护着在导航过程中根据智能体感知状态持续更新的指令状态。本方法在多项关键指标上取得显著性能提升，如在REVERIE测试集的未见场景中实现SPL指标+2.68%的增益，并在多个视觉语言导航基准测试中展现出持续的效率优势，充分验证了动态指令-感知耦合机制的重要价值。

title: Will People Enjoy a Robot Trainer? A Case Study with Snoopie the Pacerbot
summary: The physicality of exercise makes the role of athletic trainers unique. Their physical presence allows them to guide a student through a motion, demonstrate an exercise, and give intuitive feedback. Robot quadrupeds are also embodied agents with robust agility and athleticism. In our work, we investigate whether a robot quadruped can serve as an effective and enjoyable personal trainer device. We focus on a case study of interval training for runners: a repetitive, long-horizon task where precision and consistency are important. To meet this challenge, we propose SNOOPIE, an autonomous robot quadruped pacer capable of running interval training exercises tailored to challenge a user's personal abilities. We conduct a set of user experiments that compare the robot trainer to a wearable trainer device--the Apple Watch--to investigate the benefits of a physical embodiment in exercise-based interactions. We demonstrate 60.6% better adherence to a pace schedule and were 45.9% more consistent across their running speeds with the quadruped trainer. Subjective results also showed that participants strongly preferred training with the robot over wearable devices across many qualitative axes, including its ease of use (+56.7%), enjoyability of the interaction (+60.6%), and helpfulness (+39.1%). Additional videos and visualizations can be found on our website: https://sites.google.com/view/snoopie
tldr: This paper presents SNOOPIE, an autonomous quadruped robot designed to act as a personal pacer for interval running training. It demonstrates that the robot trainer significantly improves user adherence and consistency compared to a wearable device and is strongly preferred by users.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了SNOOPIE，一种用于跑步间歇训练的个人配速自主四足机器人。研究表明，与可穿戴设备相比，机器人训练师能显著提高用户的依从性和一致性，并受到用户强烈偏爱。
summary_zh: 体育锻炼的物理特性使得运动教练的角色具有独特性。他们的身体在场性使其能够引导学生完成动作、示范练习并提供直观反馈。机器人四足同样是一种具身智能体，具有强大的敏捷性和运动能力。本研究旨在探讨机器人四足能否成为有效且令人愉悦的个人训练设备。我们以跑步者的间歇训练作为案例研究：这是一项重复性、长周期且对精准度和一致性要求较高的任务。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了SNOOPIE——一种能够执行定制化间歇训练方案、根据用户个人能力调整挑战强度的自主机器人四足领跑装置。通过开展一系列用户实验，我们将机器人训练设备与可穿戴训练设备（Apple Watch）进行对比，以探究物理具身在运动交互中的优势。实验表明，在使用四足机器人训练时，用户对配速计划的遵循度提升了60.6%，跑步速度的一致性提高了45.9%。主观评估结果同样显示，在多项定性指标上参与者明显更倾向于选择机器人训练，包括易用性（+56.7%）、交互愉悦度（+60.6%）和训练辅助效果（+39.1%）。更多视频和可视化资料请访问我们的网站：https://sites.google.com/view/snoopie

title: A Comparative Evaluation of Geometric Accuracy in NeRF and Gaussian Splatting
summary: Recent advances in neural rendering have introduced numerous 3D scene representations. Although standard computer vision metrics evaluate the visual quality of generated images, they often overlook the fidelity of surface geometry. This limitation is particularly critical in robotics, where accurate geometry is essential for tasks such as grasping and object manipulation. In this paper, we present an evaluation pipeline for neural rendering methods that focuses on geometric accuracy, along with a benchmark comprising 19 diverse scenes. Our approach enables a systematic assessment of reconstruction methods in terms of surface and shape fidelity, complementing traditional visual metrics.
tldr: The paper presents a benchmark for evaluating the geometric accuracy of neural rendering methods like NeRF and Gaussian Splatting, which is crucial for robotics tasks such as grasping and manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个评估神经渲染方法（如NeRF和高斯泼溅）几何准确性的基准，这对于机器人抓取和操作等任务至关重要。
summary_zh: 近年来，神经渲染技术的进展催生了多种三维场景表征方法。虽然标准计算机视觉指标能够评估生成图像的视觉质量，但它们往往忽略了表面几何结构的保真度。这一局限性在机器人领域尤为关键，因为精确的几何结构对于抓取和物体操控等任务至关重要。本文提出了一套专注于几何精度的神经渲染方法评估流程，并构建了一个包含19个多样化场景的基准数据集。该方法能够从表面和形状保真度的角度，对重建方法进行系统性评估，从而对传统视觉指标形成有效补充。

title: Muscle-inspired magnetic actuators that push, pull, crawl, and grasp
summary: Functional magnetic composites capable of large deformation, load bearing, and multifunctional motion are essential for next-generation adaptive soft robots. Here, we present muscle-inspired magnetic actuators (MMA), additively manufactured from a thermoplastic/permanent magnet polyurethane/Nd2Fe14B (TPU/MQP-S) composite using laser powder bed fusion (LPBF). By tuning the laser-energy scale between 1.0 and 3.0, both mechanical stiffness and magnetic response are precisely controlled: the tensile strength increases from 0.28 to 0.99 MPa while maintaining 30-45% elongation at break. This process enables the creation of 0.5 mm-thick flexural hinges, which reversibly bend and fold under moderate magnetic fields without damage. Two actuator types are reported showing the system versatility. The elongated actuator with self-weight of 1.57 g, magnetized in its contracted state, achieves linear contraction under a 500 mT field, lifting 50 g (32x its own weight) and sustaining performance over at least 50 cycles. Equipped with anisotropic frictional feet, it supports movement of a magnetic crawling robot that achieves up to 100% locomotion success on textured substrates. The expandable actuator exhibits reversible opening and closing under a 300 mT field, reliably grasping and releasing different objects, including soft berries and rigid 3D printed geometries. It can also anchor in a tube while holding suspended 50 g loads. This work demonstrates a LPBF-based strategy to program both stiffness and magnetization within a single material system, enabling remotely driven, reconfigurable, and fatigue-resistant soft actuators. The approach opens new possibilities for force controlled, multifunctional magnetic soft robots for adaptive gripping, locomotion, and minimally invasive manipulation of biomedical tools.
tldr: This paper presents a novel method for creating magnetic soft actuators via 3D printing, enabling precise control of mechanical and magnetic properties for robots that can crawl, grasp, and lift objects using magnetic fields.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种通过3D打印制造磁性软体执行器的新方法，能精确控制机械和磁性能，实现了通过磁场驱动、具备爬行、抓取和举起物体能力的机器人。
summary_zh: 兼具大变形、承载能力和多功能运动的磁性复合材料对于下一代自适应软体机器人至关重要。本文提出一种仿生肌肉磁致动器，采用热塑性聚氨酯/永磁体钕铁硼复合材料，通过激光粉末床熔融技术增材制造而成。通过将激光能量密度调节在1.0至3.0之间，实现了机械刚度和磁响应的精确调控：材料拉伸强度从0.28 MPa提升至0.99 MPa，同时保持30-45%的断裂伸长率。该工艺可制造厚度仅0.5毫米的柔性铰链，在中等强度磁场下可逆弯曲折叠而无损。研究展示了两种致动器构型以体现系统多功能性。自重1.57克的伸长型致动器在收缩态磁化后，于500 mT磁场下实现线性收缩，可举升50克重物（达自重的32倍），并在至少50次循环中保持性能稳定。配备各向异性摩擦足后，可驱动磁爬行机器人在纹理基底上实现高达100%的运动成功率。可扩展型致动器在300 mT磁场下可逆开合，能可靠抓取与释放软质浆果及刚性3D打印构件等多种物体，并可在管道内锚定同时承载50克悬吊重物。本研究提出了一种基于激光粉末床熔融的单一材料系统刚度与磁化编程策略，实现了远程驱动、可重构且耐疲劳的软体致动器。该技术为开发力控型多功能磁性软体机器人开辟了新路径，可应用于自适应抓取、运动控制及生物医学器械的微创操作等领域。

title: Does "Do Differentiable Simulators Give Better Policy Gradients?'' Give Better Policy Gradients?
summary: In policy gradient reinforcement learning, access to a differentiable model enables 1st-order gradient estimation that accelerates learning compared to relying solely on derivative-free 0th-order estimators. However, discontinuous dynamics cause bias and undermine the effectiveness of 1st-order estimators. Prior work addressed this bias by constructing a confidence interval around the REINFORCE 0th-order gradient estimator and using these bounds to detect discontinuities. However, the REINFORCE estimator is notoriously noisy, and we find that this method requires task-specific hyperparameter tuning and has low sample efficiency. This paper asks whether such bias is the primary obstacle and what minimal fixes suffice. First, we re-examine standard discontinuous settings from prior work and introduce DDCG, a lightweight test that switches estimators in nonsmooth regions; with a single hyperparameter, DDCG achieves robust performance and remains reliable with small samples. Second, on differentiable robotics control tasks, we present IVW-H, a per-step inverse-variance implementation that stabilizes variance without explicit discontinuity detection and yields strong results. Together, these findings indicate that while estimator switching improves robustness in controlled studies, careful variance control often dominates in practical deployments.
tldr: This paper investigates the effectiveness of using differentiable simulators for policy gradient estimation in reinforcement learning, focusing on handling discontinuous dynamics. It introduces a new method (DDCG) for switching estimators in nonsmooth regions and an inverse-variance implementation (IVW-H) for improved variance control in robotics control tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了在强化学习中，使用可微分仿真器进行策略梯度估计的有效性，重点处理不连续动态问题。它提出了一种新方法（DDCG）用于在非平滑区域切换估计器，以及在机器人控制任务中改进方差控制的逆方差实现（IVW-H）。
summary_zh: 在策略梯度强化学习中，使用可微分模型可实现一阶梯度估计，相较于仅依赖无导数的零阶估计器能显著加速学习过程。然而，不连续的动态特性会导致偏差，并削弱一阶估计器的有效性。先前的研究通过围绕REINFORCE零阶梯度估计器构建置信区间，并利用这些边界检测不连续性来解决该偏差问题。但REINFORCE估计器因噪声问题备受诟病，我们发现该方法需要针对具体任务进行超参数调优，且样本效率较低。本文旨在探究此类偏差是否为主要障碍，以及何种最小化修正方案能够解决问题。首先，我们重新审视了先前工作中的标准不连续场景，并提出了DDCG——一种在非平滑区域切换估计器的轻量级测试方法；通过单一超参数，DDCG实现了鲁棒性能，并在小样本条件下保持可靠性。其次，在可微分机器人控制任务中，我们提出了IVW-H——一种基于每步逆方差加权实现的方案，无需显式检测不连续性即可稳定方差，并取得了显著效果。综合而言，这些研究结果表明：尽管估计器切换在受控研究中提升了鲁棒性，但在实际部署中，精细的方差控制往往更具决定性作用。

title: ESsEN: Training Compact Discriminative Vision-Language Transformers in a Low-Resource Setting
summary: Vision-language modeling is rapidly increasing in popularity with an ever expanding list of available models. In most cases, these vision-language models have parameters in the tens of billions, which is necessary for some needs, but in many cases smaller models are necessary (e.g., on edge devices or independent robotic platforms). Unfortunately, there is little research in producing light-weight models or in training them with small datasets. Inspired by the language learning progression and data sparsity in child development, in this paper, we address both of these goals in a systematic fashion. We show that two-tower encoder models are superior to one-tower encoders in low-resource settings for discriminative English tasks. We show also that incorporating traditional convolutional networks into the two-tower transformer architecture can help produce parameter efficient vision-language models. Finally, we show that the cross-modal fusion module of two-tower encoders can vary significantly in shape and size while producing the same results. In addition, we present ESsEN, a compact vision-language model that can be trained end-to-end with relatively few resources that performs as well on several tasks with only a fraction of the parameters compared to other models. The experimental results and the tools we present here make vision-language modeling more accessible to a wider variety of researchers.
tldr: The paper introduces ESsEN, a compact vision-language model trained with few resources, claiming performance parity with larger models on discriminative tasks, emphasizing efficiency for edge/robotic platforms.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了ESsEN，一种在低资源环境下训练的小型视觉语言模型，声称在多项判别任务上性能与大型模型相当，强调其在边缘或机器人平台上的部署效率。
summary_zh: 视觉语言建模的普及度正在迅速提升，可用模型的数量也在持续增加。大多数情况下，这些视觉语言模型参数规模高达数百亿，虽然这能满足部分需求，但在许多场景中（如边缘设备或独立机器人平台）往往需要更小规模的模型。然而，目前针对轻量化模型设计或小数据集训练的研究仍较为匮乏。受儿童语言学习进程及数据稀疏性特点的启发，本文系统性地解决了这两个问题。我们证明，在低资源环境下执行判别性英语任务时，双塔编码器模型优于单塔编码器；同时将传统卷积网络融入双塔Transformer架构有助于构建参数高效的视觉语言模型。此外，研究还发现双塔编码器的跨模态融合模块在保持效果不变的前提下，其形态与规模可存在显著差异。本文进一步提出ESsEN——一种紧凑型视觉语言模型，该模型能够以相对较少的资源进行端到端训练，在多项任务中仅用其他模型一小部分参数即可达到同等性能。实验成果及所提工具将推动视觉语言建模技术向更广泛的研究群体开放。

title: Efficient Federated RLHF via Zeroth-Order Policy Optimization
summary: This paper considers reinforcement learning from human feedback in a federated learning setting with resource-constrained agents, such as edge devices. We propose an efficient federated RLHF algorithm, named Partitioned, Sign-based Stochastic Zeroth-order Policy Optimization (Par-S$^2$ZPO). The algorithm is built on zeroth-order optimization with binary perturbation, resulting in low communication, computation, and memory complexity by design. Our theoretical analysis establishes an upper bound on the convergence rate of Par-S$^2$ZPO, revealing that it is as efficient as its centralized counterpart in terms of sample complexity but converges faster in terms of policy update iterations. Our experimental results show that it outperforms a FedAvg-based RLHF on four MuJoCo RL tasks.
tldr: Proposes an efficient federated RLHF algorithm using zeroth-order optimization for resource-constrained agents, demonstrating faster convergence and lower complexity than centralized methods on MuJoCo tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种基于零阶优化的高效联邦RLHF算法，用于资源受限的智能体，在MuJoCo任务上表现出比集中式方法更快的收敛速度和更低的复杂度。
summary_zh: 本文研究了在资源受限智能体（如边缘设备）的联邦学习场景下，基于人类反馈的强化学习问题。我们提出了一种高效的联邦RLHF算法，命名为基于分区和符号的随机零阶策略优化算法。该算法建立在二进制扰动的零阶优化基础上，通过设计实现了较低的通信、计算和内存复杂度。理论分析表明，在收敛速率上界方面，该算法在样本复杂度上与集中式算法相当，但在策略更新迭代中收敛更快。实验结果证实，在四个MuJoCo强化学习任务中，该算法优于基于FedAvg的RLHF方法。

title: Tool Learning Needs Nothing More Than a Free 8B Language Model
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a prevalent paradigm for training tool calling agents, which typically requires online interactive environments. Existing approaches either rely on training data with ground truth annotations or require advanced commercial language models (LMs) to synthesize environments that keep fixed once created. In this work, we propose TRUSTEE, a data-free method training tool calling agents with dynamic environments fully simulated by free open-source LMs that can be as small as 8B, including task generation, user simulation, tool simulation and trajectory evaluation, paired with an adaptive curriculum learning mechanism that controls various aspects of the task difficulty dynamically during training. Our empirical results show that TRUSTEE brings consistent improvements across various domains and outperforms all the baselines which require extra external resources for training. These confirm that, with a sufficiently sophisticated design, even simulated environments with a local 8B LM as the backbone could set a strong baseline for tool learning, without expensive annotated data, realistic human interactions, executable tools or costly verifiable environments from human experts or commercial LMs. We hope our proposed paradigm could inspire future research on environment scaling with limited resources.
tldr: Proposes TRUSTEE, a method for training tool-calling agents using only a free, open-source 8B language model to simulate dynamic environments, without requiring real-world data, human interactions, or costly commercial models.
tldr_zh: 提出了TRUSTEE方法，仅使用免费的、开源的8B语言模型模拟动态环境来训练工具调用智能体，无需真实世界数据、人类交互或昂贵的商业模型。
summary_zh: 强化学习已成为训练工具调用智能体的主流范式，通常需要在线交互环境。现有方法要么依赖带有真实标注的训练数据，要么需要先进的商业语言模型来合成一旦创建即保持固定的静态环境。本研究提出TRUSTEE，这是一种无需真实数据的方法，通过完全由免费开源语言模型（小至80亿参数）动态模拟的环境来训练工具调用智能体，该环境包含任务生成、用户模拟、工具模拟和轨迹评估模块，并搭配自适应课程学习机制，能在训练过程中动态控制任务难度的各个方面。实证结果表明，TRUSTEE在多个领域均带来持续性能提升，且优于所有需要额外外部训练资源的基线方法。这证实了通过精心设计，即使以本地80亿参数语言模型为内核构建的模拟环境，也能为工具学习建立强大基线，而无需昂贵的人工标注数据、真实人类交互、可执行工具或由人类专家或商业语言模型构建的高成本可验证环境。我们希望所提出的范式能为资源受限条件下的环境扩展研究提供新思路。

title: Chatting about Conditional Trajectory Prediction
